description.en: Client-local adaptive graphics and performance governor for Farming Simulator 25. Uses only documented Giants Engine / Settings APIs. No binary hooks. Wave 1 (v0.2): CONFIRMED capability wiring (shadows/LOD/per-light APIs) with session-only apply+restore. Auto-apply off by default. No EXPERIMENTAL/GATED/RESTART setters. No saveHardwareScalability without opt-in.
description.de: Client-lokaler adaptiver Grafik- und Performance-Governor für Landwirtschafts-Simulator 25. Nutzt ausschließlich dokumentierte Giants-Engine-/Settings-APIs. Keine Binary-Hooks. Welle 1 (v0.2): CONFIRMED-Capability-Verdrahtung (Schatten/LOD/per-Light-APIs) mit session-only Apply+Restore. Auto-Apply standardmäßig aus. Keine EXPERIMENTAL/GATED/RESTART-Setter. Kein saveHardwareScalability ohne Opt-in.
